name: rate-limiter-core
scope: The whole spec. Owns every operation of the RateLimiter protocol (src protocol.clj) and all state named by role in README.md and test-resources/IMPLICIT_SPEC.md: the user limiter (versioned config, clock, buckets) and its recorded decisions.
